field.name: opcode
field.semantic: Identifies the type of Link Layer (LL) Control PDU being transmitted. The opcode determines the format and meaning of the control message.
field.defined_values: 0x00 (LL_CONNECTION_UPDATE_IND), 0x01 (LL_CHANNEL_MAP_IND), 0x02 (LL_TERMINATE_IND), 0x03 (LL_ENC_REQ), 0x04 (LL_ENC_RSP), 0x05 (LL_START_ENC_REQ), 0x06 (LL_START_ENC_RSP), 0x07 (LL_UNKNOWN_RSP), 0x08 (LL_FEATURE_REQ), 0x09 (LL_FEATURE_RSP), 0x0A (LL_PAUSE_ENC_REQ), 0x0B (LL_PAUSE_ENC_RSP), 0x0C (LL_VERSION_IND), 0x0D (LL_REJECT_IND), 0x0E (LL_SLAVE_FEATURE_REQ), 0x0F (LL_CONNECTION_PARAM_REQ), 0x10 (LL_CONNECTION_PARAM_RSP), 0x11 (LL_REJECT_EXT_IND), 0x12 (LL_PING_REQ), 0x13 (LL_PING_RSP), 0x14 (LL_LENGTH_REQ), 0x15 (LL_LENGTH_RSP), 0x16 (LL_PHY_REQ), 0x17 (LL_PHY_RSP), 0x18 (LL_PHY_UPDATE_IND), 0x19 (LL_MIN_USED_CHANNELS_IND), All other values Reserved for Future Use.

field.name: win_size
field.semantic: Indicates the transmit window size, calculated as transmitWindowSize = WinSize * 1.25 ms, crucial for determining the timing of packet transmissions after a connection update.
field.defined_values: 0x00 (Minimum window size), 0x01-0xFF (Variable window sizes with 0xFF being the maximum)

field.name: win_offset
field.semantic: Determines the transmitWindowOffset, which is critical in timing offsets for transmissions, calculated as transmitWindowOffset = WinOffset * 1.25 ms.
field.defined_values: 0x00 (Minimum offset), 0xFF (Maximum offset), 0x100-0xFFFF (Reserved for future use)

field.name: interval
field.semantic: Determines the time interval between consecutive connection events, measured in 1.25 ms units.
field.defined_values: 0x0006 (7.5 ms) to 0xFFFF (81.91875 seconds), with specific values reserved for implementation-specific use.

field.name: latency
field.semantic: Specifies the connection slave latency, affecting the number of connection events a slave device can skip, improving battery efficiency.
field.defined_values: 0x0000 (Minimum latency), 0xFFFF (Maximum latency), Note: Specific values are determined by device capabilities and use case requirements.

field.name: timeout
field.semantic: Represents the connection supervision timeout value in the connection update procedure. It defines the maximum time (in milliseconds) that can elapse between two successful connection events before the connection is considered lost.
field.defined_values: 0x000A - 0x0C80 (Corresponds to a timeout range of 100 ms to 32.0 s, with values in multiples of 10 ms).

field.name: instant
field.semantic: Indicates the connection event count at which the new connection parameters take effect. The Instant field ensures synchronized connection parameter updates between the master and the slave.
field.defined_values: 0x0000 - 0xFFFF (Represents a connection event count, using modulo 65536 arithmetic to handle wraparounds).

field.name: chM
field.semantic: Indicates the channel map of used and unused data channels, with each bit representing a channel's usage status in the index.
field.defined_values: 0x0000000000 to 0x1FFFFFFFFF (where each bit represents a channel, 0 for unused, 1 for used, bits in positions 37, 38, and 39 are reserved for future use)

field.name: instant
field.semantic: The Instant field indicates the specific event counter value at which the new channel map becomes active in a Bluetooth connection.
field.defined_values: 0x0000-0xFFFF (Valid range, no specific reserved values documented)

field.name: code
field.semantic: The ErrorCode field in the LL_TERMINATE_IND packet specifies the reason for terminating the connection in the Bluetooth Link Layer. It is used to inform the remote device about the cause of the disconnection.
field.defined_values: 0x00-0xFF (Defined error codes, see Bluetooth Assigned Numbers for details)

field.name: rand
field.semantic: The Rand field contains a random number that is provided by the Host and used with the EDIV for encryption purposes.
field.defined_values: 0x0000000000000000 to 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF (Full 64-bit range)

field.name: ediv
field.semantic: The ediv (Encrypted Diversifier) field is used in conjunction with the Rand field to identify the Long Term Key (LTK) used for encryption during a connection.
field.defined_values: 0x0000-0xFFFF (All possible 16-bit values are valid for distinguishing different encryption sessions)

field.name: skdm
field.semantic: The SKDm field contains the master's portion of the session key diversifier.
field.defined_values: 0x0000000000000000 to 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF (All possible 64-bit values)

field.name: ivm
field.semantic: Contains the master's portion of the initialization vector used in the encryption process of the Bluetooth Low Energy connection.
field.defined_values: 0x00000000-0xFFFFFFFF (No reserved values specified, full range available for initialization vector)

field.name: skds
field.semantic: The SKDs field contains the slave's portion of the session key diversifier, used to help derive the session key for encryption.
field.defined_values: 0x0000000000000000 to 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF (Full range of 64-bit values)

field.name: ivs
field.semantic: The IVs field contains the slave's portion of the initialization vector used in the encryption process for Bluetooth Low Energy communication.
field.defined_values: 0x00000000-0xFFFFFFFF (All values are valid as they represent a 32-bit random initialization vector component)

field.name: code
field.semantic: Contains the Opcode field value of the received LLControl PDU to indicate an unknown type.
field.defined_values: 0x00-0xFF (Any Opcode value, no reserved values)

field.name: feature_set
field.semantic: Indicates the set of features supported by the master's Link Layer, with each bit representing a specific feature capability.
field.defined_values: 0x00 (LE Encryption), 0x02 (Extended Reject Indication), 0x08 (LE 2M PHY), 0x10 (Stable Modulation Index - Receiver), 0x40 (Channel Selection Algorithm #2), 0x10000 (Minimum Number of Used Channels Procedure)

field.name: feature_set
field.semantic: Contains a set of features supported by the Link Layer of both the master and slave devices in a Bluetooth connection.
field.defined_values: 0x0000000000000000 (No features supported), 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF (All features supported), values depend on specific feature support as defined in the Bluetooth specification.

field.name: version
field.semantic: Contains the version of the Bluetooth Link Layer specification.
field.defined_values: 0x00-0xFF (Version numbers as assigned by Bluetooth SIG)

field.name: company
field.semantic: The company identifier of the manufacturer of the Bluetooth Controller.
field.defined_values: 0x0000-0xFFFF (Assigned numbers, specific values are allocated to various companies by the Bluetooth SIG)

field.name: subversion
field.semantic: Contains a unique value for each implementation or revision of an implementation of the Bluetooth Controller.
field.defined_values: 0x0000-0xFFFF (All values represent unique implementations or revisions)

field.name: code
field.semantic: The ErrorCode field in the LL_REJECT_IND packet specifies the reason for rejecting a request in the Bluetooth Link Layer.
field.defined_values: 0x00-0xFF (Defined error codes, see Bluetooth Assigned Numbers for details)

field.name: feature_set
field.semantic: Indicates the set of features supported by the Link Layer of the device, including encryption, error indication, and channel selection capabilities.
field.defined_values: 0x0000000000000000 (No features supported), 0x0000000000000001 (LE Encryption), 0x0000000000000002 (Extended Reject Indication), 0x0000000000000008 (LE 2M PHY), 0x0000000000000040 (Channel Selection Algorithm #2), 0x0000000000000100 (Minimum Number of Used Channels Procedure), 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF (All features supported)

field.name: interval_min
field.semantic: Indicates the minimum value of the connection interval in the LL_CONNECTION_PARAM_REQ packet, calculated as Interval_Min * 1.25 ms.
field.defined_values: 0x0000 to 0xFFFF (All values represent valid minimum connection intervals, subject to device-specific constraints)

field.name: interval_max
field.semantic: Indicates the maximum value of the connection interval, impacting the timing of connection events.
field.defined_values: 0x0000 (0 ms), 0xFFFF (81918.75 ms), other values represent intervals in multiples of 1.25 ms

field.name: latency
field.semantic: Indicates the connSlaveLatency value, which is the number of connection events the slave can ignore, allowing for power-saving by skipping events.
field.defined_values: 0x0000 (Minimum Latency), 0xFFFF (Maximum Latency)

field.name: timeout
field.semantic: Indicates the connection supervision timeout value, which determines the maximum time between data packets before the connection is considered lost.
field.defined_values: 0x0000-0xFFFF (All values represent a supervision timeout in increments of 10 ms)

field.name: preferred_periodicity
field.semantic: Indicates a value that the conninterval is preferred to be a multiple of, in units of 1.25 ms. A value of zero means not valid and shall be ignored.
field.defined_values: 1-255 (Valid PreferredPeriodicity values), 0 (Not valid)

field.name: reference_conn_evt_count
field.semantic: The ReferenceConnEventCount field indicates the value of the connEventCounter relative to which all valid Offset0 to Offset5 fields have been calculated. It is independent of the Instant field in the LL_CONNECTION_UPDATE_IND PDU.
field.defined_values: 0 to 65535 (0x0000 to 0xFFFF)

field.name: offset0
field.semantic: Indicates the most preferred position of the anchor points of the LE connection with updated connection parameters relative to the ReferenceConnEventCount.
field.defined_values: 0 (minimum), 0xFFFF (not valid)

field.name: offset1
field.semantic: Indicates the possible values of the position of the anchor points of the LE connection with the updated connection parameters relative to the ReferenceConnEventCount.
field.defined_values: 0x0000 to 0xFFFF (0xFFFF indicates an invalid value, other specific valid values are less than Interval_Max and should be unique and precede any invalid values)

field.name: offset2
field.semantic: Indicates the possible values of the position of the anchor points of the LE connection with the updated connection parameters relative to the ReferenceConnEventCount.
field.defined_values: 0x0000 to 0xFFFE (Valid values less than Interval_Max), 0xFFFF (Not valid)

field.name: offset3
field.semantic: Indicates the possible values of the position of the anchor points of the LE connection with the updated connection parameters relative to the ReferenceConnEventCount.
field.defined_values: 0x0000 to 0xFFFF (Values less than Interval_Max, unique among Offset0 to Offset5, and in decreasing order of preference)

field.name: offset4
field.semantic: Indicates a possible value for the position of the anchor point of the LE connection with updated parameters relative to the ReferenceConnEventCount.
field.defined_values: 0x0000 to 0xFFFE (Valid, with Offset4 less than Interval_Max), 0xFFFF (Invalid)

field.name: offset5
field.semantic: Indicates the possible value of the position of the anchor point of the LE connection with the updated connection parameters relative to the ReferenceConnEventCount.
field.defined_values: 0x0000 to 0xFFFE (Valid values less than Interval_Max), 0xFFFF (Not valid)

field.name: interval_min
field.semantic: Indicates the minimum value of the connection interval in multiples of 1.25 ms, crucial for determining the frequency of connection events and power management.

field.name: interval_max
field.semantic: Specifies the maximum connection interval, which affects the frequency at which the master and slave will communicate.
field.defined_values: 0x0006-0xFFFF (Valid range; values must be greater than or equal to Interval_Min and conform to other constraints such as supervision timeout)

field.name: latency
field.semantic: Indicates the connSlaveLatency value, representing the number of connection events the slave device can skip, hence affecting power saving and latency.
field.defined_values: 0x0000-0xFFFF (Valid range for connSlaveLatency)

field.name: timeout
field.semantic: The Timeout field indicates the connSupervision Timeout value, calculated as Timeout * 10 ms, representing the maximum time between two received data packets before the connection is considered lost.

field.name: preferred_periodicity
field.semantic: The preferred_periodicity field is set to indicate a value the conninterval is preferred to be a multiple of, in units of 1.25 ms. A value of zero means not valid. The PreferredPeriodicity shall be less than or equal to Interval_Max.
field.defined_values: 0x00 (Not valid), 0x01-0xFF (Valid values within the range as multiples of 1.25 ms up to Interval_Max)

field.name: reference_conn_evt_count
field.semantic: Indicates the value of the connEventCounter relative to which all the valid Offset0 to Offset5 fields have been calculated.
field.defined_values: 0x0000 to 0xFFFF

field.name: offset0
field.semantic: The Offset0 field in the LL_CONNECTION_PARAM_RSP packet indicates the most preferred offset for connection events in units of 1.25 ms. It helps synchronize the new connection parameters by defining anchor points.
field.defined_values: 0x0000-0xFFFE (Valid offsets), 0xFFFF (Invalid offset)

field.name: offset1
field.semantic: The offset1 field is part of the LL_CONNECTION_PARAM_RSP packet and indicates the preferred timing offset for connection events. It is used in determining when the next connection event should occur, with offset1 being the next preferred value after offset0.
field.defined_values: 0x0000-0xFFFF (0xFFFF indicates the value is not valid, valid values must be unique and less than Interval_Max)

field.name: offset2
field.semantic: Offset2 is part of a sequence of offsets (Offset0 to Offset5) used for connection event timing, expressed in units of 1.25ms, with Offset0 being the most preferred. The value must be less than Interval_Max and should be unique among Offset0 to Offset5.
field.defined_values: 0x0000 to Interval_Max-1, 0xFFFF (not valid)

field.name: offset3
field.semantic: The Offset3 field in the LL_CONNECTION_PARAM_RSP packet indicates one of the possible positions of the anchor points of the LE connection with the updated connection parameters. These offsets are in units of 1.25 ms and are ranked in decreasing order of preference.
field.defined_values: 0x0000-0xFFFE (Valid offsets, unique within the set), 0xFFFF (Invalid offset)

field.name: offset4
field.semantic: The offset4 field is part of the LL_CONNECTION_PARAM_RSP packet and is used to indicate the preferred offset value for the connection event, in units of 1.25 ms. It should be less than Interval_Max and represent a unique, valid value.
field.defined_values: 0x0000-0xFFFE (Valid offsets less than Interval_Max), 0xFFFF (Invalid)

field.name: offset5
field.semantic: The Offset5 field in the LL_CONNECTION_PARAM_RSP packet indicates a potential anchor point position for the LE connection with updated parameters. It is expressed in units of 1.25 ms and is ranked lowest in preference among Offset0 to Offset5 fields.
field.defined_values: 0x0000-0xFFFE (Valid offsets, unique within the set), 0xFFFF (Invalid offset)

field.name: reject_opcode
field.semantic: Contains the Opcode field value of the LL Control PDU being rejected.
field.defined_values: 0x0D (LL_REJECT_IND), 0x0E (LL_SLAVE_FEATURE_REQ), 0x0F (LL_CONNECTION_PARAM_REQ), 0x10 (LL_CONNECTION_PARAM_RSP), 0x11 (LL_REJECT_EXT_IND), 0x12 (LL_PING_REQ), 0x13 (LL_PING_RSP), 0x14 (LL_LENGTH_REQ), 0x15 (LL_LENGTH_RSP), 0x16 (LL_PHY_REQ), 0x17 (LL_PHY_RSP), 0x18 (LL_PHY_UPDATE_IND), 0x19 (LL_MIN_USED_CHANNELS_IND), 0x00-0x0C, 0x1A-0xFF (Reserved for future use)

field.name: error_code
field.semantic: The ErrorCode field in the LL_REJECT_EXT_IND packet specifies the reason the LL Control PDU was rejected. It helps identify the issue in establishing a Bluetooth connection or processing a control message.
field.defined_values: 0x1A (Unsupported Remote Feature / Unsupported LMP Feature), 0x3B (Unacceptable Connection Parameters), 0x00-0xFF (Error Codes as defined in [Vol 2] Part D, with some values reserved for future use)

field.name: max_rx_bytes
field.semantic: Specifies the maximum number of octets that the sender can receive, ensuring that the sender does not announce a capability lower than 27 octets.
field.defined_values: 0x001B-0xFFFF (Minimum value 27 octets, no maximum defined)

field.name: max_rx_time
field.semantic: Specifies the maximum time the sender is capable of receiving a packet, in microseconds, ensuring compatibility with the receiver's capabilities.
field.defined_values: 0x0148 (328), 0xFFFF (65535), Values in between are valid, but must be greater than or equal to 328 microseconds.

field.name: max_tx_bytes
field.semantic: Specifies the maximum number of octets that the sender is willing to transmit in a single packet over the connection.
field.defined_values: 0x001B (27) to 0xFFFF (65535), values below 0x001B are not valid.

field.name: max_tx_time
field.semantic: Specifies the maximum time, in microseconds, that the sender allows for a packet transmission on a connection, influencing data throughput and timing constraints.

field.name: max_rx_bytes
field.semantic: Indicates the maximum number of octets the sender of the LL_LENGTH_RSP packet can receive.
field.defined_values: 0x001B to 0xFFFF (Minimum value of 27 octets; no explicit maximum value defined in the document)

field.name: max_rx_time
field.semantic: The max_rx_time field specifies the maximum time, in microseconds, that the sender allows for the reception of a single packet. It is used to negotiate the maximum allowable time for packet reception between devices during a Bluetooth connection.
field.defined_values: 328-2120 (Range for standard and LE Coded PHY feature; values less than 328 are invalid for MaxRxTime, values greater than 2120 are used when LE Coded PHY feature is supported)

field.name: max_tx_bytes
field.semantic: The MaxTxOctets field shall be set to the sender's connMaxTxOctets value, with a value not less than 27 octets, determining the maximum number of octets the sender intends to transmit in a single packet.
field.defined_values: 0x001B (27 octets) to 0xFFFF (65535 octets; theoretical maximum), with values below 27 being invalid.

field.name: max_tx_time
field.semantic: The max_tx_time field is used to set the sender's maximum transmission time for data packets, ensuring that it supports the specified time without exceeding it, with a minimum value of 328 microseconds.
field.defined_values: 0x0148 (328 microseconds minimum), 0x0848 (2120 microseconds maximum for devices not supporting LE Coded PHY), 0x0000-0xFFFF (Theoretical range, but values below 328 are not valid)
